fields.name: text
fields.label: Text
fields.description: Content card: title and description. The eyebrow and the CTA button come from the Topic and Link fields below.

fields.name: topic
fields.label: Topic
fields.description: Eyebrow text. The eyebrow links to the parent page of Link. Leave blank to show that parent page's name.

fields.name: ctaLink
fields.label: Link
fields.description: Page the CTA button links to. The eyebrow links to this page's parent.

fields.name: ctaLinkText
fields.label: CTA text
fields.description: CTA button text. Leave blank to show "Read more".

fields.name: classes
fields.label: Presentation
fields.description: Optional modifiers. Full width removes the rounded container; alignment controls which side the content card sits on; Dynamic eyebrow ignores Topic and shows the name of the Link's parent page.
